government_and_permits.notes: Statutory licence fee for erecting temporary tentage on state land or public road verge outside private landed premises.

deposit_policy.terms: An initial deposit of 30% of the taxable subtotal (including GST) is payable upon contract sign-off and before wake setup or body collection begins. The remaining 70% balance plus any signed interim daily add-ons are due on the final cortege procession day prior to crematorium or cemetery entry.
accepted_payment_methods: 0% Interest Monthly Installment Plan (6 or 12 months via DBS/POSB, OCBC, UOB)

cancellation_and_refunds.cooling_off_rule: Clients are entitled to a full refund within 24 hours of agreement execution, provided operational dispatch has not commenced.

tiered_deductions.description: Administrative registration, file opening, and permit queuing started.
Transport team dispatched and deceased collected from hospital or residence.
Embalming, body care, and cosmetological styling completed.
HDB void deck tentage or parlour hall fully erected and utility meters tapped.

tiered_deductions.fee_calculation: 100% of selected package and scheduled upgrades
tiered_deductions.description: Cancellation on final procession day is non-refundable.

bundle_discounts.name: Pre-Planning Advance Contract Discount
bundle_discounts.eligibility: Advance pre-planning contracts signed and deposited prior to acute need.

bundle_discounts.name: 5-Day Wake Package Bundle Rebate
bundle_discounts.eligibility: Applied when bundling 5-day duration with Faith/Value packages.

bundle_discounts.name: Public Service / Healthcare / SAFRA Family Rebate
bundle_discounts.eligibility: Direct family members of civil servants, healthcare workers, or SAFRA members.

bundle_discounts.name: Direct Cremation Full Settlement Rebate
bundle_discounts.eligibility: Immediate upfront full PayNow settlement for Direct Cremation packages.

incompatible_services.explanation: NEA crematorium safety regulations strictly prohibit metal, copper, and bronze caskets in cremator chambers. Batesville bronze and copper models are exclusive to Choa Chu Kang Ground Burial.

incompatible_services.rule_name: Soka Gakkai and Christian/Catholic Incense & Joss Paper Restriction
incompatible_services.explanation: Soka Gakkai, Christian, and Roman Catholic traditions maintain a strict prohibition against joss paper effigies and burning rituals.
Direct Cremation packages do not include wake visitation. Selecting multi-day wake logistics requires upgrading to a standard wake package.

upgrade_downgrade_rules.trigger: Family requests 3-day public wake visitation with void deck setup and coordinator.
upgrade_downgrade_rules.cost_differential_estimate: Base price increases from S$1,500 to S$3,200 - S$5,888 depending on tradition.

upgrade_downgrade_rules.trigger: Family requests full white fabric drapery, Mercedes-Benz hearse, enlarged portrait styling, night staff, and beverage chiller.
upgrade_downgrade_rules.cost_differential_estimate: Base price increases from ~S$4,999 to S$9,333 - S$14,988.

upgrade_downgrade_rules.trigger: Family requests solid Burmese teak casket, bespoke floral wall, VIP limousine escort, and 24/7 Butler concierge.

deferred_payment_and_assistance.comcare_scheme_details: Eligible low-income Singaporean families can receive up to S$1,800 under the MSF ComCare Funeral Assistance Scheme. Our coordinators assist in filing direct claims.
deferred_payment_and_assistance.cpf_medisave_and_dps_support: Guidance provided for next-of-kin utilizing deceased's CPF Dependants' Protection Scheme (DPS) payouts or bank account disbursements.

variable_definitions.base_price: Numerical integer price of the selected base package (e.g. 4999).
variable_definitions.taxable_subtotal: The net pre-tax total for all commercial goods and services provided by the funeral director.
variable_definitions.gst_amount: Singapore 9% Goods and Services Tax applied to taxable_subtotal (rounded to 2 decimal places).
variable_definitions.statutory_permits_total: SUM(selected_government_and_permits.statutory_fee_sgd) - passed through at cost with 0% GST markup.
variable_definitions.grand_total: Total invoice commitment payable by the client.
variable_definitions.deposit_amount: Upfront 30% commitment required before operations commencement.
variable_definitions.balance_amount: Final 70% balance payable on cortege departure day.
